posts.title: Book review: “Chicago’s Art Deco Skyscrapers” by Joseph Gustaitis
posts.description: Near the end of Chicago’s Art Deco Skyscrapers, Joseph Gustaitis rhapsodizes about the huge, imposing Merchandise Mart. Actually, Gustaitis does a lot of rhapsodizing in telling the story of the city’s twenty Art Deco tall-tower jewels, an exquisite collection of art and commerce.
